text: This staff report is about a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This is a report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing & Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard café permit located at 2592 Yonge Street, Albertus Avenue flankage.
North York Community Council: 1. Denied the application for the proposed boulevard café permit located at 2592 Yonge Street, Albertus Avenue flankage.
